name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataStoreId.description: dataStoreId is the identifier for the data store that provides the tab title data.

pageParamsId.description:
pageParamsId is the identifier for the page parameters associated with the tab title.
The variable name defined for the component should match the parameter in the contextVars of the data store.
Example: If the data store contextVars has "entityId": "${entityId}", then pageParamsId should be "entityId".

buttonActionsMapKey.description:
The path to the key that should be used to get the action buttons from the {@link #buttonMap}


This key needs to be set in the {@link UiApDataStore} referenced by {@link #dataStoreId}.

dataPathConfig.description:
dataPathConfig is an object that defines the paths for title, subtitle, and context.
- titlePath: Path to the title field in the data store (e.g., "name").
- subtitlePath: Path to the subtitle field in the data store (e.g., "facility.name").
- contextPath: Array of paths for additional context info (e.g., ["name", "facility.name"]).
Example:
  dataPathConfig: {
    titlePath: "name",
    subtitlePath: "facility.name",
    contextPath: ["name", "facility.name"]
  }

buttonMap.description:
buttonMap is a mapping of active tab identifiers to arrays of action button configurations.
Each action button configuration includes properties like label, iconSuffix, actionSuffix, tooltip,
variant, and disabled state.
Example:
  buttonMap: {
    "TabId": [
      {
        label: "Button Label",
        iconSuffix: "icon-suffix",
        actionSuffix: "action-suffix",
        tooltip: "Button Tooltip",
        variant: "primary",
        disabled: false
      }
    ]

editable.description: Editable flag to indicate if the title can be edited.

leftIcon.description: The icon rendering on left side of the tab title.

tabs.description: List of tab objects (e.g., Configure, Validate, Monitor).

statusTag.description: Tag object to display on the top right (e.g., DRAFT, CANDIDATE).
